title: Standing Outliers
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

There are $N$ people on a number line. The people are numbered $1$ to $N$, and person $i$ is at coordinate $X_i$. Multiple people may be at the same coordinate.

A person is said to "stand apart" if their distance to every other person is at least $D$.

Formally, person $i$ is said to "stand apart" if $|X_i-X_j| \geq D$ holds for all $j ~ (1 \leq j \leq N,\ j \neq i)$.

Output the numbers of all people who "stand apart" in ascending order.

## Constraints

- $2 \le N \le 100$
- $1 \le D \le 10^9$
- $1 \le X_i \le 10^9$
- All input values are integers.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N D
X_1 X_2 \dots X_N
```

## Output

Let $K$ be the number of people who stand apart, and let $(P_1,P_2,\dots,P_K)$ be the sequence of their numbers sorted in ascending order. Output them in the following format:

```
K
P_1 P_2 \dots P_K
```

If $K=0$, the second line should be empty.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

数轴上有 $N$ 个人。人们的编号为 $1$ 到 $N$，第 $i$ 个人位于坐标 $X_i$。多个 人可能位于同一坐标。

如果一个人与其他每个人的距离都至少为 $D$，则称这个人“独立突出”。

形式化地说，对于所有满足 $j ~ (1 \leq j \leq N,\ j \neq i)$ 的 $j$，若均有 $|X_i-X_j| \geq D$，则称第 $i$ 个人“独立突出”。

请按升序输出所有“独立突出”的人的编号。

## 约束条件

- $2 \leq N \leq 100$
- $1 \leq D \leq 10^9$
- $1 \leq X_i \leq 10^9$
- 所有输入值均为整数。

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
N D
X_1 X_2 \dots X_N
```

## 输出格式

设独立突出的人数为 $K$，将这些人的编号按升序排列后得到序列 $(P_1,P_2,\dots,P_K)$。请按以下格式输出：

```
K
P_1 P_2 \dots P_K
```

当 $K=0$ 时，第二行应为空。

samples.note:
Person $1$ has distance $4$ to person $2$ and distance $6$ to person $3$, so their distance to every other person is at least $D$. Thus, person $1$ "stands apart".
Person $2$ has distance $2$ to person $3$, so person $2$ does not "stand apart".
Similarly, person $3$ has distance $2$ to person $2$, so person $3$ does not "stand apart" either.

Thus, only person $1$ "stands apart".
There may be people at the same coordinate. Also, if no one "stands apart", the second line should be empty.
Output the numbers of the people who "stand apart" in ascending order.
